timing_policy: All times are proposed operating experiments, not proven optimum posting times. Keep local London times stable; calculate UTC using Europe/London, not a fixed offset.

publication_policy.execution: Manual publication after owner review. This JSON is a plan, not a scheduler or permission to message people.
publication_policy.private_messages: No unsolicited DMs or email campaign. Existing waitlist consent promises one readiness email.

objectives.target_note: Targets and baselines are unknown. Establish them before launch; do not invent figures.

timezone_transition.effect: BST becomes GMT. Oct 27 LinkedIn 09:30 local is 09:30 UTC; Bluesky 16:00 local is 16:00 UTC. Before Oct 25 these same local slots are 08:30 and15:00 UTC.

content_source_contract.identifier: content_source.post_id selects the matching object in content.json posts[]. The json_pointer and copy_field identify the exact copy entry.
content_source_contract.asset_directory: Paths are relative to the campaign package. Standard cards are graphics/P01.png through graphics/P12.png, with matching editable SVGs. P04 LinkedIn instead uses the five-page PDF checklist in carousel/; P04 Bluesky keeps the square card.
content_source_contract.mastodon: Four optional adaptations use P02/P05/P08/P11 short_copy with the Bluesky UTM source replaced by mastodon. Final adapted copy is included in its placement and targets at most 450 characters, preserving room within the default 500-character limit. Verify actual instance policy.
content_source_contract.hacker_news: Use top-level show_hn_title and first_comment from content.json. Submit the direct /download/ tracking URL; no image attachment is planned.

channel_plan.cadence: Weekly Thursday adaptations Oct 1/8/15/22, only if an appropriate account is already active
One eligible Show HN submission only

excluded_channels.reason: No promotional Reddit posts in this campaign. r/DataHoarder requires prior moderator approval and disallows AI-generated content; r/selfhosted readiness and project-age requirements have not been established. Do not repurpose the campaign copy there.

setup_checklist.task: Confirm the founder LinkedIn profile and existing Bluesky account; record handles privately. Confirm an already-active, suitable Mastodon account before keeping optional placements.
Review P01–P12 copy against the currently downloadable alpha and public roadmap. Planned capabilities must stay clearly marked planned.
Open each 1200x1200 PNG at mobile size. Check logo, legibility, demo-data labels and descriptive alt text. Keep Bluesky images under 1.8 MB.
Test every UTM URL and early-access form. Check the CLI download/quickstart independently before promising a working install.

Current analytics are off and waitlist records store only at and lang. Keep tracking links, but report per-channel signup conversion as unavailable. Use native platform reach/link-click exports, aggregate waitlist changes and GitHub release asset download deltas; do not enable analytics.

Before launch, record aggregate waitlist total, per-asset GitHub release download_count and available native platform metrics. Agree realistic goals using these baselines; do not treat them as unique users or precise attribution.
Reserve the daily 15-minute manual reply window and weekly 30-minute review. Reserve Oct 6 16:30–18:30 London only if Show HN eligibility passes.
Confirm the calendar uses Europe/London and inspect Oct 27 slots after BST ends Oct 25. Nothing has been scheduled in a platform.

baseline.note: Unknown until measured. Record GitHub release asset counts by release tag and asset filename, plus available native platform exports. Keep unavailable values null, never zero by assumption.

definitions.aggregate_waitlist_count_change: End total minus start total for the period. This is net list growth, may reflect removals or other traffic, and cannot be assigned to a particular channel with the current storage.
definitions.platform_link_clicks: Native platform click metric only when the platform exposes it. It is not a unique-user, signup, completed-download or install count.
definitions.github_asset_download_delta: Difference in the public GitHub release asset download_count for the same asset between observations. Counts may include repeat downloads and automated activity; they are not unique people or acquisitions.
definitions.qualified_feedback: A substantive question, reproducible report or practical use case; record without unnecessary personal data.

utm_convention.utm_medium: organic_social for social platforms; referral for Hacker News
utm_convention.utm_content: lowercase P01–P12 content ID; show_hn for the one conditional submission

measurement_plan.attribution_caveat: Tracking links are prepared for consistent naming, but current website analytics are off and waitlist records contain only at and lang. Per-channel signup conversion is unavailable until separately implemented and approved. Do not infer precise channel conversions or new-user acquisition from platform reach/clicks, aggregate waitlist change or GitHub asset download deltas.

Native platform reach/impressions and link-click exports where available

Meaningful replies and recurring feedback themes

weekly_reviews.decision: Keep, adjust or stop topics using observed platform interest and useful replies; review aggregate signup/download changes separately. Treat small samples as directional, change one variable at a time, and record the decision.
weekly_reviews.unavailable_metric_note: Per-channel signup conversion is not measured. Leave it null; do not estimate it from other counts.
